name: narrativetrace-java
description: Install NarrativeTrace in a Java project and reach a first trace, diagnose an install that traces nothing, add or verify a Clarity naming report, verify a change by reading what its code actually did and pin it as an approval baseline, find the cause of a wrong result by reading the values at each span, explain what an unfamiliar flow actually does by running it and reading the trace, and report a defect in NarrativeTrace itself with your approval.

interface.longDescription: Install NarrativeTrace in a Java project and reach a first trace, diagnose an install that traces nothing, add or verify a Clarity naming report, verify a change by reading what its code actually did and pin it as an approval baseline, find the cause of a wrong result by reading the values at each span, explain what an unfamiliar flow actually does by running it and reading the trace, and report a defect in NarrativeTrace itself with your approval. It reads what one run actually did, and needs a JDK, this project's build tool, and network access for the first dependency fetch.
defaultPrompt: add narrative tracing to my service
